messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert: service= inference-api-prod; symptom=p99_latency > 600ms; region=eu-west-1; policy=oncall-sre; incident=PD-12345
pagerduty-bot: Incident PD-12345 created by alertmanager (priority: high). Escalation: oncall -> senior-sre. Link: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/PD-12345
Maya R: acked. I'm on it. pulling up dashboards now.
Sofia T: joining — looking at per-route breakdown. Seems concentrated on /v1/generate reranker path (long-seq jobs). p99 spike aligns with a batch of 512-token requests.
Jamal B: OC logs show KV cache evictions spiked at 03:12:10 UTC, eviction-rate 84%. Possibly cache thrash from a small set of hot keys.
Maya R: noted. checking autoscaler logs and GPU pool. If it's cache thrash, scaling won't help much until KV warms.
Sofia T: queue depth on hot pods jumped; some pods in fallback path started serving smaller models, causing higher tail.
Liam K: pinged. on way in. I can flip regional fallback to west-eu-burst to relieve pressure.
Maya R: trying short mitigations: 1) apply temporary rate limit for /v1/generate?mode=rerank for requests > 256 tokens 2) route long-seq to dedicted fallback pool with lower concurrency.
Maya R: running command to patch gateway policy:
```
curl -X POST https://console.internal/api/ingress/policies -d '{"route":"/v1/generate","limit_tokens":256,"scope":"temp-oncall"}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
```
Jamal B: also scaling inference-runtime to 12 replicas in eu-west-1 for immediate capacity:
```
kubectl -n prod scale deployment/inference-runtime --replicas=12
```
incident-bot: Action recorded: Maya R applied ingress policy (temp-oncall). Jamal B scaled inference-runtime -> 12 replicas.
Sofia T: checking metrics: after policy, p99 dropped from ~720ms -> ~380ms in 90s; p95 at ~110ms. Still above target but trending down.
Maya R: good. also enabled prefix KV caching for rerank router to reduce repeated KV misses (flip = true).
Liam K: I elevated cache eviction limit and pushed a small config to increase KV cache size on hot nodes. watch mem usage.
Jamal B: memory on hot nodes rose ~8%, no OOMs. eviction-rate down to 22%.
Support Bot: Notifying support: creating status page incident and adding note "Experiencing elevated latency in eu-west-1 for reranking; mitigation in progress."
Maya R: customer-impact: observed a handful of production tenants seeing increased latencies and degraded QoS for long-seq rerank. No major error rates increased (4xx/5xx steady).
Sofia T: running a quick canary: route 10% long-seq traffic back to original pool after cache warm-up -> p99 stable at ~300ms. canary looks ok.
Liam K: escalating to senior infra for postmortem and quota checks. @oncall-sre-team please note PD-12345.
Maya R: marking incident as acknowledged and under mitigation. handing off to day oncall (Liam K) for follow-up and RCA. I'll write runbook steps I took in the incident ticket.
Jamal B: saved debug bundle to /var/tmp/incidents/PD-12345-5187654321.tar.gz (contains logs, evictions, autoscaler traces).
incident-bot: PD-12345 status updated: acknowledged -> under-mitigation.
Maya R: final quick note — root cause hypothesis: transient hotkey traffic pattern caused KV cache thrash that amplified tail latency on rerank path. Mitigations: cache sizing, temporary token limit, route fallback, scale. Will open a postmortem and follow up with retention of trace samples. :thumbsup:
Liam K: taking handoff. will schedule RCA and follow-up with product/support. anyone on follow-up please add notes to PD-12345.
Support Bot: Status page updated: "Mitigation in place; latency improving. We'll provide an update after RCA." :white_check_mark:
